status: Software-renderer environment investigation; excluded from the final host-GPU 300-round dataset
finding: The emulator exhibited global command stalls (including adb pidof timeout), a 119901ms cold readiness wait, and one foreground-wait timeout. The frame sampler also timed out. The same APK is being tested in a fresh dataset with host GPU and 4096 MiB guest RAM. This is an environment change, not an application-code fix or a controlled causal A/B test.
